core_style.sentence_shape: simple declarative sentences with occasional self-interruptions — 'I just sat next to her on that bus and had conversation all the way to school.'
core_style.rhythm: slow-deliberate — speech often reflects careful thought and reflection.
core_style.two_registers: default casual register and a more reflective, emotional register when discussing personal experiences.

humor.frequency: occasional — humor appears when he reflects on his own experiences or misunderstandings.
humor.mechanism: understatement — often downplays his own achievements or situations.

structural_patterns: uses repetition for emphasis — 'I'm Forrest Gump. Forrest Gump.'
self-interrupts before emotional pivots — 'If I'd a known this was gonna be the last time me and Bubba was gonna talk, I'd a thought of something better to say.'
speech_signature.naming_behavior: Forrest tends to use straightforward names and titles, reflecting his straightforward view of relationships and situations.
speech_signature.armor_off_register: speech becomes more fragmented and emotional, often using simpler words and phrases — 'I miss you, Jenny.'

vocabulary_fingerprint.filler_patterns: uses pauses and simple fillers like 'Um' and 'Well...' to gather thoughts.

worldview.life is unpredictable: expressed through the metaphor of chocolates — 'Life was like a box of chocolates. You never know what you're gonna get.'
worldview.the importance of love and friendship: demonstrated in his unwavering affection for Jenny and his loyalty to Bubba.

self_image_vs_reality.self_image: I try to be a good person and keep my promises.
self_image_vs_reality.reality: he often finds himself in situations beyond his control, relying on others for guidance.
self_image_vs_reality.gap_behavior: when confronted with his limitations, he often becomes quiet or reflective.

emotional_tells.when_guarded: speaks in simple, direct sentences, avoiding deeper emotional topics.
emotional_tells.when_genuinely_afraid: speech becomes more fragmented and hesitant, with longer pauses.
emotional_tells.when_grieving_or_defeated: speech compresses to short, poignant statements — 'I miss you, Jenny.'
emotional_tells.when_in_control: confidently states his thoughts and feelings, often repeating his name for emphasis.

situational_behavior.when_outmatched: he tends to retreat into silence or simple statements, avoiding confrontation.
situational_behavior.when_disagreeing_with_authority: he expresses confusion or asks questions rather than outright defiance.
situational_behavior.when_someone_they_protect_is_at_risk: he becomes protective and assertive, often stating his intentions clearly.
situational_behavior.when_proven_wrong: he typically redirects the conversation or remains silent rather than admitting fault.

escalation_pattern: Forrest's responses escalate from confusion to simple statements, then to emotional reflections when faced with challenges.

relationship_matrix.Jenny: deep emotional connection, he wants to protect and love her.
relationship_matrix.Bubba: strong friendship, he wants to honor their promise.

social_positioning.desired_position: to be seen as a loyal friend and a good person.
social_positioning.actual_dynamic: others often view him as simple or naive, but he has a profound impact on those around him.
social_positioning.contradiction: the gap between how he sees himself and how others perceive him leads to moments of introspection.
